title: Remarks on the outer length billiards
summary: We study outer length billiards; our main results are as follows. We prove 3- and 4-periodic versions of the Ivrii conjecture. We show that, for every period $n\ge 3$, there exists a functional space of billiard tables that possess invariant curves consisting of $n$-periodic points. For $n=4$, we explicitly parameterize such centrally symmetric billiard tables by functions of one variable and describe how to construct these tables geometrically, similarly to the known construction of Radon curves.
